title: Path Sum III
summary: Determine the count of paths in a binary tree where the sum of node values along the path equals a specified target sum.
statement: Determine the count of paths in a binary tree where the sum of node values along the path equals a specified target sum. Paths must descend from parent to child nodes, but do not have to begin at the root or end at a leaf.
constraints: Count nonempty parent-to-child paths. They may begin or end at any node, not only root or leaves.
Different node paths count separately even if their values are identical. The function receives TreeNode objects or None.
